local_acceptance.source_rows: all native rows for density and bootstrap CV; functional groups remain legacy sparse
local_acceptance.independent_review: 12 file hashes verified; 10 regional/coastal/nodata probes and 6 composition-gap cases checked
local_acceptance.gpu_sampling: 24 calibrated probes passed; 21/24 agree with ideal float64 filtering within 0.5%; remaining thin-coast discrepancies up to 2.18% explained by independently measured filter weights and half-float rounding
local_acceptance.coverage_and_orientation: production coverage gate and six-face geographic orientation probes passed
local_acceptance.viewer: bound v2 512-face object; opening, fully swept veil, uncertainty toggle and regional view inspected
local_acceptance.limits: not ecological validation, a new population estimate, seam certification or a filtered/raymarched mass-conservation claim; marine data unchanged

format: RGBA16Float little endian; row-major py,px,channel; flipY=false

channels.R: ln(all-cell area-mean nematodes/m^2), supported zero floor 1e-30
channels.G: coarse composition numerator: fraction times independent groups_support; unknown when groups_support=0; never normalize with A
channels.B: support-weighted mean native pixel bootstrap CV, not CV of aggregate count
channels.A: valid-model area fraction; NOT ocean mask; empty gate only, never multiply R again

georeferencing: independent channel geographic cell edges; cube geocentric to WGS84 geodetic latitude

provenance.transformation: spherical overlap-area mean; invalid source contributes no known soil mass; validity separate
provenance.point_support: midpoint cells, clipped to destination domain

groups.formula: (omnivores+predators)/sum(five independently modeled groups), then support-weighted interpolation
groups.limitation: coarse sparse-row source support; zero denominator is missing composition, not fraction zero

validation.area_convention: R=6371000 sphere; all source conservation gates include the geocentric-to-geodetic Jacobian; renderer_geocentric_integral uses raw solid angle and is not gated against the geodetic source
validation.limitations: texel-center quadrature; not a filtered/raymarched GPU image integral; regional/coastal diagnostics require independent review

renderer_conversion.rounding: three.js float32 then float16 toward zero; density recovered by dividing exp(logTau) by optical area

group_support.decode: filter G and groups_support at identical directions/LOD, divide only when support > 0; otherwise unavailable
group_support.source_fidelity: legacy sparse 512x256 groups; not upgraded by this cube
